scope: Runner-only explicit performance shortcut between owned diagnostic runs; C RomFS verification, backend, builders, profiles and saves unchanged.
default: Without this option every fresh run has an empty private cache and performs the existing full C image SHA256 verification before RomFS ready.
prior_validation: Canonical direct host-* child of the same work/runs; prior run/cache/logs mode0700 owned directories without symlink aliases.
Owned regular no-hardlink/no-symlink files, bounded O_NOFOLLOW reads; marker/log/compiled sidecar/proof require0600. Existing receipt.json may be0600 or0644, never group/other writable.

Exact title and marker format; completed run receipt binds canonical run/log/command, exact logSHA+size, prior binarySHA and no remaining owned process-group pids. Prior log must contain actual matching C verification and RomFS-ready lines.

Exact prior compiled-build-receipt.json must exist and bind the old run binary hash, work/title/diagnostic status, same runtime/romfs.c sourceSHA and expected canonical image path/size/hash, file count, indexSHA and configSHA as current build.

Current binary digest and codesign verification remain mandatory. Current RomFS C source/config/index digests and staged canonical image path/size are checked independently; Python never reads the whole image in reuse mode.
Source proof must be exactly160B with actual C magic, expected imageSHA+NUL and image size. Recorded marker/compiled/proofSHA fields are enforced when present.
copy_and_authority: Only byte-exact C-produced cache/.romfs-verified-v1 is copied into a distinct fresh run private cache using O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW0600, fsync and independent readback. No stat fields are rewritten, and builder expected-digest records never become runtime proofs.

The original unchanged C fstat/proof_equal compares actual current device/inode/size/mtime/ctime/birthtime and expected digest. Any mismatch requires a full C image SHA256 check; the C verifier is final authority.
Index bytes are always independently hashed by C. Metadata reuse is not a fresh content hash or a claim against adversarial metadata forgery.

new_run_receipt.compiled_build_receipt: Exact source build-receipt bytes saved0600 as compiled-build-receipt.json before launch, even when reuse is not requested.
new_run_receipt.bindings: run markerSHA, compiled sidecarSHA, output runtime proofSHA when ready, prior receipt/log/sidecar/proofSHA and source paths for requested reuse.
new_run_receipt.classification: Only exact C log sequence followed by matching native read-only RomFS ready grants a verification mode; starting a hash, copying a proof, or failing before ready earns no completed-hash credit.

validation.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s native-target/tests -p test_host_runner_proof.py -v
validation.native_fixture: Real arm64 C runtime/romfs.c with a20B image and one real binary index entry; strict scratch guard and actual unchanged SHA256/proof_equal code. Fixture executes no guest or GPU instructions.
end_to_end: Default actual runner performs full C hash and saves exact compiled receipt
Unchanged actual image accepts byte-exact copied160B C proof in a separate run
Same-size mutated image misses actual C metadata check, performs full SHA and fails RomFS integrity before ready
negative_coverage: whole-image Python read forbidden in reuse helper
approved historical extra-bindings explicitly marked absent
validation.independent_peer_review: Root and probe read-only source/test reviews found no material issues; peer made no edits and ran no tests.
validation.remaining: First real game diagnostic run with this runner option remains for root. No fresh real3.6GB image hash or real-game proof-reuse success is claimed by this source-only stage.
